messages:
alex: Heads-up: seeing a small tail of WS connections where our socket-fingerprint header flips mid-session and the router picks a different shard. Console heatmap shows route change spikes + short double-quota blips.

susan: ugh. any repro or logs?

alex: pasted a snippet from a user session — note fingerprint header changing from fpt=42a to fpt=7b3 after a quick TLS renegotiate.
```
GET /ws?session=abc123  
Host: api.redwood.ai
Upgrade: websocket
Sec-WebSocket-Protocol: rw-stream-v1
X-Socket-Fingerprint: fpt=42a;age=2s

... 
(tls renegotiate happens)
X-Socket-Fingerprint: fpt=7b3;age=0s
```

jun: is the proxy recomputing fingerprint on handshake resume? that would explain route pref change.

carla: when route_id changes mid-session ledger currently attributes tokens to new route. that can look like two short charges. we've seen the same pattern in quota logs earlier (route swap + tiny token bursts).

ops-bot: alert: route-change-spike detected for tenant=acme-corp (count 14 in 5m)

tim: console UX question: heatmap currently merges route ids but we don't highlight mid-session flips. we should surface a small note on session timeline: "route swapped" so SRE + billing can triage.

alex: short-term mitigation idea: if fingerprint changes within 10s of previous value, treat it as "sticky tentative" and keep routing sticky to original shard for N seconds. avoids double-charge and reduces UX noise.

susan: would that hide real rebinds? e.g., true client migration should still re-route. can we make rule: only apply sticky if session token and connection id remain same and we saw a tls-renegotiate event in proxy?

jun: implementation sketch: proxy add 2 fields in routing context: orig_route_id and last_fingerprint_ts. if new fingerprint && (now - last_fingerprint_ts) < 10s && conn_id unchanged -> route = orig_route_id. also emit telemetry tag `route.swap.sticky_blocked=true` when blocked.

carla: on billing side we can dedupe charges by looking for `session_id + short time window + route.swap.sticky_blocked` tag. cheaper fix than changing ledger logic.

ops-bot: FYI: this will be in next oncall rotation notes.

tim: consoles changes: add an overlay on heatmap dots that were sticky-blocked with tooltip: "fingerprint jitter suppressed" and a link to session trace. small color, helps support.

alex: OK owners: (proxy) @jun to prototype sticky heuristic, (billing) @carla to add dedupe-by-tag hook, (console) @tim to add heatmap annotation. i'll open a short RFC + rollout plan. propose canary for 24h in us-west cluster then global.

susan: +1. let's watch for regressions: possible real mobile handoffs could be suppressed; add metric `sticky_blocked_true_positive` vs `false_positive` via sampling.

jun: will do a small flag `sticky_route_jitter_window=10s` behind feature flag for canary. PR incoming.

carla: i'll add billing dedupe filter and a console badge for any tenant-level hits.

alex: thanks. I'll file follow-ups: link to trace sample + sample prod logs in RFC. :thumbsup:
